description: Make a draft event live. Pass event_id for a draft you host — one made by duplicate_event, or saved in the studio. Or pass draft_id + edit_token to finish a create_event_draft draft whose one-step publish failed (e.g. after set_profile_name). Outward-facing: the event becomes public and bookable per its visibility, so confirm with the host first. Uses one monthly event credit. Calling it on a live event returns it unchanged. Requires a connected account.
name: publish_event
title: Publish Event
